spec_trace.roadmap_pointer: Kernel reset brief Week 6 Account, Principal, Resource Authority, Access Space, and Persona/CRM Layers; Phase C.

preservation_contract.product_concept_rename: The existing product Profile/persona concept is canonically named Persona. The WP filename and stable ID remain unchanged.
original_intent_carried_forward: Multiple preference/personality contexts can exist under one authenticated identity.
Switching the context changes memory retrieval, suggestions, preferences, and project/client presentation without changing authority.
FEMS memory is scoped to the active personalization context and cross-context retrieval is explicit.
CRM preferences, repeated patterns, recent activity, and project/client associations remain local-first and operator-reviewable.
Native switcher/admin UI and typed switch events remain required.
new_scope_added: Persona belongs to LocalAccount and is independent of AccessSpace.
Client/contact/project/resource associations always pass through WP-KERNEL-007 ResourceGrant authorization.
FEMS, CRM, suggestions, moodboards, inspiration, and imported SaaS provenance are ProtectedResources.
Visible account + Space + Persona context prevents operator confusion.
Local moodboard/project-starter/inspiration features provide a future remote-service landing seam.
superseded_draft_assumptions: Persona is not a content visibility boundary.
Projects/resources are not owned by Persona and are not authorized by Persona.
Adult/SFW isolation that must be secure is implemented by separate ResourceGrants/AccessSpaces; Persona only personalizes authorized content.
The design is not limited to single-digit Personas or a solo operator.
CRM and FEMS stores require account/Space/resource scope even when the Persona matches.

naming_contract.Persona: account-owned preferences, behavior, presentation, and memory-personalization bundle
naming_contract.Client: CRM entity associated with authorized projects/resources but not an authorization subject by itself
naming_contract.ProjectProfile: existing project-type/workflow extension concept, not Persona

scope.intent: Implement Persona, CRM, preference learning, FEMS personalization, and client/project/inspiration workflows on top of the account/resource authorization foundation without ever using personalization as access control.
in_scope: Persona UUID v7 schema, ownership by LocalAccount, lifecycle, label/kind/presentation/preferences/memory-policy fields, archive/delete, and deterministic bootstrap.
Persona preference categories, consent/enablement per category, provenance, review/edit/purge, retention, and disable behavior.
Authenticated-session active_persona_id pinned separately from access_space_id.
Atomic Persona switch event and behavior for open surfaces, queued work, cached suggestions, and in-flight model sessions.
Explicit invariant that Persona associations do not create ResourceGrants or widen query scope.
CRM Client and Contact schemas scoped to account and AccessSpace with ProtectedResource identity.
Client-to-project/resource associations that resolve only authorized ResourceRefs.
CRM activity/preference/recent-pattern capture with operator review, category controls, retention, purge, and EventLedger attribution.
FEMS memory rows gain LocalAccount, AccessSpace, Persona, source-resource, grant/policy version, and provenance scope.
FEMS retrieval first authorizes account/Space/source resources, then applies Persona ranking/filtering.
Cross-Persona memory retrieval only by explicit operator action and only within already-authorized resources.
Suggestion engine and preference learning with strict account/Space query scope and Persona personalization.
Local moodboard, inspiration collection, and project-starter records with ProtectedResource/lineage integration.
Imported Handshake SaaS/MCP moodboard/inspiration/project-starter provenance and quarantine-to-Persona association after WP-KERNEL-007 authorization.
Backend APIs and native Persona/CRM/client/moodboard/inspiration UI.
Persistent visible account + AccessSpace + Persona context and warnings when a switch leaves work pinned to the prior context.
Real PostgreSQL, FEMS, model-context, search, CRM, switch-race, deletion, import, UserManual, EventLedger/Flight Recorder, and Argus proof.
out_of_scope: Credentials, account lifecycle, Principal, AccountRole, and foundational RLS owned by WP-KERNEL-006.
AccessSpace, ResourceGrant, MembershipRole, ResourceBroker, visitor, MCP, and remote connection authorization owned by WP-KERNEL-007.
Production SaaS backend, external CRM providers, billing, or federation.

enforcement_order: emit derived resource with non-widened scope and lineage
mandatory_negative_scenarios: same Persona label under different accounts
Persona switch attempts to reveal another Space
same project/client but no grant to a private resource
FEMS row matches Persona but source resource is revoked
suggestion/search count leaks unauthorized project existence
Persona deletion leaves orphaned memory or widens fallback scope
in-flight model session crosses Persona/Space switch silently
remote inspiration import bypasses quarantine or local grant

selected_patterns: separate identity, authorization context, and personalization context
local protected-resource landing for later remote sync
rejected_patterns: Persona-only FEMS filter without account/Space/source authorization

activation_acceptance: WP-KERNEL-006 and WP-KERNEL-007 are implemented and Integration Validator-verified.
Refinement locks Persona, CRM, FEMS, client/project associations, switch atomicity, deletion, tracking categories, moodboard/inspiration, and imported-provenance contracts.
Refinement proves Persona never grants and maps every query to account/Space/source-resource authorization first.
Official packet adopts the complete pre-created MT index without silent deletion.
A new WP activation signature is obtained.

risks_and_hardening.failure_scenario: switching to SFW/adult/client Persona changes visible resources or grants
risks_and_hardening.hardening: separate columns/APIs/UI, authorization-first query order, invariance tests

risks_and_hardening.risk: FEMS or suggestions leak private work
risks_and_hardening.hardening: account+Space+ResourceGrant+source authorization before Persona ranking; revoked-source test

risks_and_hardening.failure_scenario: behavior categories accumulate without awareness or purge
risks_and_hardening.hardening: opt-in categories, provenance, review/edit/purge, retention controls, visible status

risks_and_hardening.failure_scenario: open model/editor uses mixed old/new Persona or Space context
risks_and_hardening.hardening: pinned immutable run context, explicit continue/restart decision, cache invalidation, typed event

risks_and_hardening.failure_scenario: SaaS moodboard import becomes visible across accounts/clients
risks_and_hardening.hardening: WP-KERNEL-007 quarantine and ResourceGrant first, then optional Persona association

microtasks.adoption_rule: Activation Manager must compare refinement/packet scope to every pre-created MT, preserve each original Persona/CRM/FEMS obligation, record any split/merge/supersession, validate the DAG, and activate no more than one MT at a time.

minimum_controls: No product implementation may begin from this stub or its inactive MTs.
Refinement must prove authorization occurs before Persona personalization.
Different-account same-label Personas, revoked-source memory, switch races, and remote-import quarantine are mandatory scenarios.
